narration.en: Memory, HBM & Storage leads the themes (durability durable); leadership is broad (23/34 themes in uptrend); suggested cash 30%.
narration.zh: 内存、HBM 与存储 领跑主题（持续性强）；领跑面 广泛（23/34 个主题处于上行趋势）；建议现金 30%。

ranks.name: Memory, HBM & Storage
ranks.thesis: This basket tracks the AI-memory cycle: DRAM and high-bandwidth memory (HBM) for accelerators, NAND flash, and the enterprise HDD/SSD storage that AI data buildout demands. It is driven by memory pricing cycles, HBM capacity sold to GPU makers, and hyperscaler storage capex — a monitoring lens on the cycle, not a buy list.

ranks.name: AI Neoclouds & HPC Hosting
ranks.name_zh: AI 新云与高性能算力托管
ranks.thesis: A basket of GPU-cloud and AI-HPC hosting pure-plays — "neoclouds" renting Nvidia capacity to AI labs plus ex-bitcoin miners converting power and datacenter shells into compute leases — driven by hyperscaler capex, GPU supply, power availability, and signed take-or-pay contracts. Treat it as a monitoring lens on the AI compute buildout, not a buy list: names are early-stage, capital-intensive, lease-concentrated, and highly volatile.

ranks.name: AI Semiconductors
ranks.thesis: AI Semiconductors tracks the silicon supply chain behind AI compute — merchant GPUs, custom training/inference ASICs, the networking chips that lash accelerators together, and the power and server hardware around them — driven by hyperscaler and enterprise capex on training and inference buildouts. It is a monitoring lens on the AI-compute cycle, not a buy list.

ranks.name: AI Infrastructure
ranks.thesis: The picks-and-shovels of the AI build-out: compute, memory, networking, power and thermal. Levered to data-center capex rather than model monetization — the first to inflect up on an order cycle and the first to roll over when capex digestion arrives.

ranks.name: Critical Minerals & Rare Earths
ranks.thesis: The ex-China critical-mineral supply chain that 2025–26 policy is trying to onshore: rare-earth and magnet producers (MP, USAR, UUUU), lithium (ALB, SGML, LAC), antimony (UAMY, PPTA) and other defense-critical metals (NB niobium, ALM tungsten, CRML). A high-headline-beta cluster that moves on DoD/EXIM/DOE deals as much as commodity spot — genuine producers and pre-revenue developers are deliberately mixed and flagged. A monitoring lens, not a buy list.

ranks.name: Semiconductor Equipment (WFE)
ranks.name_zh: 半导体设备（晶圆厂设备）
ranks.thesis: Wafer-fab equipment (WFE) and metrology vendors are the pick-and-shovel layer of the AI build-out, selling the deposition, etch, litho-adjacent and inspection tools plus subsystems that enable leading-edge logic, HBM/DRAM and advanced packaging; the cycle is driven by fab capex, foundry/memory utilization and China localization spend. This is a monitoring lens for capex-cycle and AI-supply-chain breadth, not a buy list.

ranks.name: Non-AI Tech & Hardware
ranks.thesis: Diversified legacy tech: enterprise IT, networking gear, connectors and broad-line analog/MCU/power chips whose demand rides industrial, auto and datacenter capex rather than the AI-accelerator boom. Driven by inventory normalization, the industrial/auto cycle and infrastructure spend — a monitoring lens on the non-AI side of tech, not a buy list.

ranks.name: Managed Care & Insurers
ranks.thesis: Health insurers and managed-care orgs — defensive cash flows whipsawed by the medical-loss-ratio cycle and Medicare Advantage rate notices. A policy-and-utilization trade more than a growth one.

ranks.name: Quantum Computing
ranks.thesis: The quantum-compute frontier: liquid pure-plays spanning trapped-ion (IONQ, QNT), superconducting (RGTI), annealing (QBTS), photonic (QUBT) and neutral-atom (INFQ), plus the deep-pocketed big-tech programs (IBM, GOOGL, MSFT) and the GPU bridge (NVDA, via Honeywell HON). Still the NISQ era — this is a high-beta option on a narrative, not a fundamentals book. A monitoring lens, not a buy list.

ranks.name: Data-Center Power & Cooling
ranks.thesis: The picks-and-shovels of the AI buildout: switchgear, transformers, busways, power-conversion and liquid-cooling gear that moves megawatts from the grid into GPU racks, driven by surging hyperscaler capex and grid-electrification demand. A monitoring lens on the power bottleneck of AI, not a buy list.

ranks.name: Space Economy
ranks.thesis: The commercial space build-out across every segment: launch (RKLB, FLY, SPCX), direct-to-device cellular (ASTS), satcom incumbents (IRDM, VSAT, MDA), Earth observation (PL, BKSY), defense-space (KTOS, LUNR) and propulsion/components (RDW, KRMN). Heavy on post-SPAC and brand-new IPOs — high beta and dilution risk are the rule. Names that turned into merger-arb (GSAT) or spectrum plays (SATS) are excluded. A monitoring lens, not a buy list.

ranks.name: Power & Grid Buildout
ranks.thesis: The electricity supply chain for AI + electrification: generation, grid equipment and the IPPs selling power to data centers. A multi-year demand-growth story after two decades of flat US load; rate-case and rate-of-return regulation is the governor.

ranks.name: Reshoring & Industrial Capex
ranks.thesis: Beneficiaries of onshoring and the US industrial-capex super-cycle: automation, power distribution, machinery and the equipment-rental layer. Levered to factory construction and IRA/CHIPS spending; sensitive to rates and the capex cycle turning.

ranks.name: Travel & Experiences
ranks.thesis: Travel and experiences — airlines, cruises, lodging and gaming. The 'experiences over goods' consumer trade; high operating leverage cuts both ways and it's first to roll over on a consumer slowdown.

ranks.name: Regional Banks
ranks.thesis: Mid- and large-regional lenders — the cleanest expression of the yield curve, CRE credit and deposit competition. Re-rate on steepening and rate cuts; the tail risk is CRE losses and a deposit-flight repeat.

ranks.name: Cybersecurity
ranks.thesis: Pure-play security software spanning endpoint, network firewalls, identity/access, vulnerability management and cloud-native protection, driven by ransomware/breach risk, AI-attack escalation, zero-trust adoption and platform consolidation onto fewer vendors. This is a monitoring lens on the theme's relative strength and dispersion, not a buy list.

ranks.name: Uranium & Nuclear Fuel
ranks.thesis: The fuel side of the nuclear revival: producers (CCJ, UEC, UUUU, URG), tier-1 developers (NXE, DNN), the only royalty pure-play (UROY) and the US enrichment/HALEU layer (LEU, ASPI) that the AI-power and SMR build-out depends on. Driven by uranium spot, utility contracting and US fuel-independence policy — distinct from the reactor/utility names in the Nuclear & SMR basket. A monitoring lens, not a buy list.

ranks.name: GLP-1 & Obesity
ranks.thesis: The incretin/GLP-1 complex that reshaped pharma: the LLY/NVO duopoly that owns the economics, the oral and next-gen pure-plays racing to the second wave (several washed out — Terns, Metsera, Catalent are gone), the fill-finish and CGM supply chain that benefits, and the dialysis names the drugs threaten. A monitoring lens on the most consequential drug narrative of the decade, not a buy list.

ranks.name: Nuclear & SMR Power
ranks.name_zh: 核电与小型模块化反应堆
ranks.thesis: Nuclear power as the carbon-free baseload bet on surging AI-datacenter electricity demand, spanning reactor-owning utilities, early-stage SMR/microreactor developers, and the fuel-and-services chain that supplies them. Driven by hyperscaler power-purchase deals, pro-nuclear policy, and grid scarcity — this is a monitoring lens on the theme, not a buy list.

ranks.name: Industrial Distribution & Capital Goods
ranks.thesis: Tracks MRO/industrial-distributor volumes & pricing, equipment-rental fleet utilization and short-cycle tooling demand — a monitoring lens on the industrial restock/capex pulse, not a buy list.

ranks.name: Robotics & Automation
ranks.thesis: Robotics & Automation captures companies building the machine vision, motion control, surgical robots and factory software that drive industrial productivity, geared to capex cycles, labor costs and reshoring. Treat it as a monitoring lens on the automation theme, not a buy list.

ranks.name: Defense & Aerospace
ranks.thesis: Primes and defense-tech levered to a rising global budget cycle: missiles, aircraft, space and the new autonomy entrants. Long-cycle backlog visibility; the cross-current is procurement reform and budget-ceiling risk.

ranks.name: Housing Chain
ranks.thesis: The housing chain — builders and building-products — geared to mortgage rates and the structural under-supply of US homes. Rate-cut beneficiaries with order-cancellation risk if rates stay high.

ranks.name: AI Software & Platforms
ranks.thesis: Apps and platforms trying to MONETIZE AI rather than supply it — the contested leg. Re-rates on seat expansion and inference demand, de-rates when AI is feared to deflate seat-based software. The wide spread inside this basket is the whole point.

ranks.name: Defensives
ranks.thesis: Staples and defensive cash-flows — the low-beta ballast that leads in risk-off and lags in risk-on. A relative-performance regime tell more than an absolute-return engine; GLP-1 and private-label are the structural cross-currents.

ranks.name: Magnificent Seven
ranks.thesis: The mega-cap complex that drives index returns and breadth: Apple, Microsoft, Nvidia, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta and Tesla. When the Seven lead, the tape is narrow; when they lag, leadership is broadening. A concentration gauge, not a buy list.

ranks.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
ranks.thesis: Pure crypto-asset beta — the US exchange (COIN), the bitcoin-treasury proxy (MSTR), the USDC stablecoin issuer (CRCL) and spot-ETH (ETHA). Miners that pivoted to AI/HPC moved to AI Neoclouds; the retail broker (HOOD) moved to Fintech. A regime sensor, not a buy list.

ranks.name: Insurance & Brokers
ranks.thesis: Tracks the hard-vs-soft underwriting cycle, rate-on-line, reserve adequacy and float investment income across P&C, life and brokers — a monitoring lens on the insurance cycle, not a buy list.

ranks.name: Retail
ranks.thesis: Big-box, off-price and discount retail — a consumer-health and trade-down gauge. Off-price and discounters win in a stretched consumer; discretionary big-box is the spend-confidence tell.

ranks.name: Payments & Fintech
ranks.thesis: Card networks and payment processors — secular cash-to-card plus consumer-spend cyclicality, now with the AI/stablecoin disruption overhang on the processors.

ranks.name: Big Pharma
ranks.thesis: Tracks branded-pharma/big-biotech pipeline progress, patent-cliff exposure, drug pricing and M&A — a monitoring lens on the large-cap drug complex, not a buy list. Excludes the GLP-1/obesity leaders (own basket).

ranks.name: US Energy Complex
ranks.thesis: The US energy complex end-to-end: integrateds, E&P, oilfield services, refiners and midstream. A crude-price + capital-discipline trade; midstream adds a data-center-power/natgas demand kicker.

ranks.name: Non-AI Software
ranks.thesis: Enterprise application and infrastructure SaaS franchises whose value rests on seat growth, net-revenue retention and durable subscription economics rather than the AI story — driven by software budgets, deal cycles, rates (long-duration multiples) and the SaaS net-retention regime. A monitoring lens on classic-software leadership, not a buy list.

ranks.name: AI Agents & Applications
ranks.thesis: The AI application and agent layer — where models become revenue. Enterprise agentic platforms (PLTR, NOW, CRM) and AI-native or AI-levered apps (APP, DUOL, SOUN). Deliberately split out from AI Software & Platforms (which mixes in data-infra and dev-tools) to isolate the monetization-of-agents narrative. The app layer inherits roughly the index's forward edge — this is an accountability/structure lens, not an oracle, and not a buy list.

vol_overlay.note_en: Optional de-risk overlay — scale the book toward a ~26% vol target. Backtested on 27y of clean sector history it cut max-drawdown by ~7.5pp (CI [1.0, 7.5, 17.2]) and beat a trend-only brake, but it does NOT lift Sharpe (you trade CAGR for a shallower drawdown) — so it is OFFERED, not forced.
vol_overlay.note_zh: 可选降风险叠加 — 将组合缩放至约 26% 波动率目标。在27年干净行业历史回测中，最大回撤降低约 7.5pp（区间 [1.0, 7.5, 17.2]），并优于纯趋势刹车；但不提升夏普（以CAGR换取更浅回撤）— 故为可选项而非强制。

allocation.rule: Equal-weight the top-4 themes above their own 200d trend (the validated dual-momentum book), DE-OVERLAPPED to at most 1 per parent super-theme so the book stays diversified; idle slots sit in T-bills; crowded themes are trimmed toward cash; capped at 30%/theme.

verdict.relative_momentum: modest_or_none — cross-sectional rank-IC weak/insignificant on the clean sector universe; an attention/focus lens, not alpha.
verdict.absolute_trend_gate: validated_risk_control — no mean-return edge but materially lower volatility & shallower drawdown/tail; the staying-power leg.
verdict.basket_extension: no_basket_drawdown_edge — extension predicts per-NAME crashes, not diversified basket drawdown; keep as constituent texture only.
verdict.rotation_timing: display_only — no validated early-handoff forecast (cf. group_flow).

ai_handoff.reader_contract: This ranks where thematic LEADERSHIP and FLOW are concentrating and suggests a trend-following, vol-aware allocation. The ONE validated edge (multi-decade sector backtests) is DRAWDOWN/shake-out avoidance via the absolute-trend gate — NOT return forecasting. Momentum rank ≈ a focus lens (rank-IC ~0 on clean sectors). Use to size & de-risk, then judge narrative durability yourself.
do_not_conclude: Do NOT read the momentum rank as a return forecast or a buy list.
Do NOT treat crowding/extension as a SELL, a SHORT, or a basket-drawdown timer (it has no basket-level forward edge; it only DOWN-SIZES).
Do NOT fade the dominant theme on a crowding flag — cap it, do not fade it (reflexivity; fading the leader is the documented failure mode).
Do NOT predict the NEXT narrative — only flag a CONFIRMED leadership handoff.
Do NOT treat thematic-ETF inflows or attention spikes as a BUY (they mark tops).
ai_handoff.ai_directive: Permitted: name the prevailing narrative, judge its durability from breadth/cohesion/trend-health, flag crowding as a sizing caution, and describe the one-narrative-vs-everything structure. Produce ONE falsifiable conditional lean with a check-by horizon. FORBIDDEN: directional certainty, fade calls, next-theme prediction, or letting any of this feed a score.
